description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1807/17 of 24.04.2013 - Cad. Map No. 521001
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and amendment of title registration records for a specific parcel of land. It contains detailed information about land location (village, division, district), cadastral map references, and specific encumbrances being added to the title register. The document is explicitly published in "PART III - LANDS" and involves the Commissioner of Title Settlement making amendments to land title records under the Registration of Title Act, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4).
